name: Curve CRV/ETH Vyper lock reentrancy
summary: Vyper 0.3.0 allocated the same named nonreentrant lock to different storage slots in different functions. The CRV/ETH pool's native-ETH callback therefore allowed cross-function reentrancy from remove_liquidity() into add_liquidity(), minting an invalid claim on pool reserves.
notes: The immutable Vyper pool runtime was deployed in this transaction and remained byte-identical immediately before the exploit.

The two structured components are the attack helper's exact end-of-transaction proceeds after repaying its 10,000 WETH flash loan. The later 2,879.65 ETH whitehat extraction was returned to Curve and is excluded. Other Vyper-affected pools were attacked independently and are not included in this pool-specific loss.
